**Praktiserende kardiologer** (practicing cardiologists) represent a newly integrated group of medical specialists within the [[atrieflimren-i-danmark|Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) database. As of June 1, 2023, their formal affiliation with the AFDK was established, marking the first time that data from this specific private practice sector has been included in the national annual report [^src1]. This inclusion reflects a broader paradigm shift in Danish healthcare reporting, moving from a strictly hospital-centered model to a comprehensive, population-based quality measurement strategy across sectors [^src1].

During the reporting period, a total of 15 practicing cardiologists contributed data, covering 5% of all incident patient pathways for atrial fibrillation [^src1]. The geographic distribution of these specialists is heavily concentrated in the capital area. [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] hosts the vast majority with 13 specialist practices [^src2]. The remaining practices are distributed with 2 in [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] [^src2] and 1 in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] [^src2]. 

By integrating these specialists, the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) strengthens its evidence base for political and clinical decision-making. The data provided by the practicing cardiologists is crucial for evaluating treatment standards, resource allocation, and the overall quality of care for chronic heart diseases across the entire healthcare continuum.
